contract.service: Explicit headless DynamicDisplays and PendantDisplay, using captured static variables or supplied ports
contract.unknown: UNINITIALIZED/UNKNOWN_BYTE scalar or port values, whole UNINITIALIZED label arrays and UNINITIALIZED selected labels display stars with last_status 1
contract.invalid: Missing captured cells, changed reference locations/schema, malformed label ARRAY layout, invalid selected values or declared STRING capacity overflow display question marks with last_status 4
contract.index: Zero-based enum/INTEGER port index is checked against the declared label count before reading whole unknown labels; out-of-range is last_status 2
contract.recovery: Polls can recover from repaired data at the original captured location. Selected ARRAY rows keep captured cells and reject a resized containing list.
contract.initiation: Declared BOOLEAN labels still require two cells. Validate surface storage and recheck the captured status reference after sampling before initial paint or registration.
contract.poll: Prepare every due window's printable rows, dimensions, fields and aggregate history capacity before publishing any window. Rejected explicit polls preserve grids, history, elapsed time, binding status/text and deadlines.
contract.background: Source checkpoints retain grids/history and deadlines on repaint failure, advance logical time and mark due bindings last_status 5 without preventing source cleanup
contract.cancel: Ordinary cancellation validates every affected window before clearing fields or removing watches. Repair and retry. Interrupted cleanup attempts each window and releases the interrupted run's bindings even if a surface cannot paint.
contract.persistence: Cancel all bindings before saving ordinary JSON. No captured locations, active references, background task, GUI or live controller state are serialized.

boundaries: Offline Pythonic statuses and logical checkpoint timing; no strict/native/controller equivalence
Preflight covers the built-in model's deterministic validation failures; no rollback of arbitrary host callback side effects or overridden paint methods
No automatic source-reference rebinding, controller storage repair or active-watch persistence
